title: 题型与解题步骤
goal: 判断简短话语的功能，并按功能、预想回应、排除的顺序选择回应。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 听力

sources.title: ETS：TOEFL iBT Test 2026 Update — Test Blueprint and Specifications
sources.used: 题量、难度范围、录音长度、只放一遍

sources.title: ETS：Updated TOEFL iBT Test Overview
sources.used: 各题型的说明、考查的能力、官方样题

sources.title: ETS：TOEFL iBT Listening Lesson Plans（教师用教案）
sources.used: 第 1 课：四类题的说明和小测答案；第 2、4 课：应答配对、重音和语调

body.p: 听句子选回应：听一句问句或陈述句，从 4 个书面回应中选出最合适的一项。听到的句子不显示在屏幕上。选择的依据是这句话的用意。

body.box:
Where is the repair desk? → At the end of this corridor.
Could you carry this crate? → Sure, I can take it upstairs.

body.p: Where 问地点，回应要给出地点。Could you 加动作是请求，回应要表明做不做，或者说明条件。两句都是问句，功能却不同。

steps.d: 从疑问词、动作和语气判断说话的目的。Where is the repair desk? 是问信息，Could you carry this crate? 是请人帮忙。
先想好回应该给出什么信息或态度，不必想具体措辞。听到 Where，预想一个地点。听到 Could you carry，预想搬还是不搬。
逐项看选项是否回应了这个目的，人物和时间是否一致。I carried it yesterday 说的是过去，没有答复现在的请求。

cards.title: 话语功能
rows: 提问：信息
给出所问的信息，只重复名词不算回答。
Who repairs these clocks? → The technician downstairs.
提问：确认
确认或说明情况，可以不说 yes 或 no。
Is the scanner available? → Someone's using it just now.
请求或提议
表明做不做这件事。
Shall we test the microphone? → Yes, let's try it now.
陈述：困难
针对这个困难提供帮助或建议。
The zip on my bag is stuck. → Let me take a look.
陈述：消息
对消息的结果作出反应，如祝贺或遗憾。
Our design was selected. → That's wonderful news.
寒暄或感叹
回应问候或情绪。
It's good to see you again. → It's been a long time.

body.box: Would you mind moving your bicycle away from this doorway?

Choose the best response.
1. I moved into this building last year.
2. Of course. I'll put it beside the fence.
3. The doorway is wider than it looks.
4. No thanks, I can move it myself.

body.p: 步骤 1：Would you mind moving 是请求，要对方把自行车挪开。doorway 说明车挡在门口，不是在问门在哪里。
步骤 2：回应应表明挪不挪车。第二项先答 Of course，再说把车放到栅栏边，答应了请求。
步骤 3：第一项把 moving 理解成搬家。第三项只描述门口。第四项把请求当成对方要帮忙，答话的人弄错了。三项都没有处理挡在门口的自行车。

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: 词义改变
move the bicycle → move into a building
核对动词的宾语和整句含义。
只给相关信息
move the bicycle → I ride it to work.
核对是否回应当前要求。
时间不符
Could you move it? → I moved it yesterday.
过去做过，不是答应现在去做。
功能不符
Where is it? → It opens at nine.
问地点，要答地点，不答时间。
照搬字面
Shall we test it? → It is a test.
先听出这是提议，不看是否重复了 test。

lines.text: Which drawer holds the spare batteries?

options: They're in the lowest one.
The spare batteries are new.
Yes, I'll get some for you.
No, I don't need any batteries.
items.why: Which drawer 问哪个抽屉，第一项指出是最下面那个。第三项用 Yes 回答 which 的问题，接不上。

lines.text: Could you turn down the radio while I make this call?

options: The call lasted ten minutes.
The radio was a birthday gift.
Sure, I'll lower the volume.
Thanks, but I can turn it down myself.
items.why: Could you turn down 是请对方把音量调小，第三项答应了，lower the volume 对应 turn down。

lines.text: The handle on my suitcase has come loose.

options: The handle was expensive.
Let me tighten it for you.
I came here last month.
Thanks, I'll tighten it myself later.
items.why: has come loose 说的是把手松了，第二项提出帮对方拧紧。第四项像在谢绝帮助，说话人弄反了。

lines.text: It's nice to finally meet the person behind these cartoons.

options: The cartoons are in this folder.
You're welcome; I'll show you more.
Yes, I met him last year.
I'm glad we could meet at last.
items.why: nice to finally meet 是初次见面的客套话，第四项用 meet at last 回应。

lines.text: When will the repaired watch be ready?

options: At the watch repair counter.
It needed a new spring.
By Thursday afternoon.
The repair costs fifteen dollars.
items.why: When 和 be ready 问什么时候修好，第三项给出时间。其余三项分别答了地点、原因和费用。

lines.text: Shall we sort the donated coats by size?

options: Yes, let's make separate piles.
The largest coat is wool.
No thanks, I can sort them alone.
I wore a smaller size then.
items.why: Shall we 是提议一起按尺码分类，第一项同意，并说分成几堆。

lines.text: I'm sorry I left your umbrella on the train.

options: The train was quite crowded.
You're welcome; it was no trouble.
I'm sorry; I'll buy you a new one tomorrow.
That's all right; these things happen.
items.why: I'm sorry 是道歉，第四项用 That's all right 接受道歉。第三项是回答的人在道歉，说话人弄反了。

lines.text: Thanks for showing me how to use the sewing machine.

options: The machine uses strong thread.
You're welcome; I'm glad it helped.
I showed the machine yesterday.
That's all right; it wasn't your fault.
items.why: Thanks for showing 是道谢，第二项用 You're welcome 回应。第四项是回应道歉的话。

lines.text: Where should I leave this parcel for collection?

options: The collection begins at four.
The parcel weighs two kilos.
Beside the dispatch counter.
I collected a parcel yesterday.
items.why: Where should I leave 问放在哪里，第三项给出地点：发货柜台旁边。第一项答的是时间。

lines.text: Would you check whether this ladder is steady?

options: Sure, I'll hold it and check.
The ladder has six steps.
The check was completed yesterday.
Thanks, but I can check it myself.
items.why: Would you check 是请对方检查梯子，第一项答应扶住梯子检查。第三项说的是过去。

lines.text: The map on this walking trail is torn.

options: Don't worry; I know you didn't mean to tear it.
The map was printed last year.
I tore some paper this morning.
There's another map at the next junction.
items.why: is torn 说明这张地图没法用，第四项告诉对方下一个路口还有一张。第一项把这句话当成了道歉。

lines.text: I'm delighted that we finally found a rehearsal space.

options: I'm sorry; I'm sure we'll find one soon.
So am I; now we can practice together.
The space has two entrances.
You're welcome; it took me all week.
items.why: I'm delighted 表达高兴，第二项用 So am I 回应同样的心情。第一项把好消息听成了坏消息。

lines.text: How many plates do we need for the pottery display?

options: About twelve should be enough.
The display lasts two weeks.
The plates go on the upper shelf.
We need them by Friday.
items.why: How many plates 问数量，第一项答大约 12 个。其余三项分别答了时长、位置和期限。

lines.text: Why don’t we compare the two fabric samples in daylight?

options: No thanks, I can compare them myself.
Yes, we compared them yesterday.
Good idea; let's take them outside.
The darker sample costs more.
items.why: Why don’t we 是提议在日光下比较，第三项同意，并说把样品拿到外面。

lines.text: Have the replacement wheels arrived yet?

options: The wheels fit the smaller cart.
They're still on their way.
Sure, I'll order them for you.
Thanks, I'll fit them tomorrow.
items.why: arrived yet 问到了没有，第二项说还在路上，即还没到。第三项把问题当成了请求。

lines.text: I appreciate your help setting up the chess boards.

options: The boards are made of wood.
Don't worry; it wasn't your fault.
Yes, I set them up yesterday.
Happy to help with the setup.
items.why: I appreciate your help 是道谢，第四项用 Happy to help 回应。第二项是回应道歉的话。
